fato_historico: 1861: American Civil War: The Confederate States of America accept a rival state government's pronouncement that declares Missouri to be the 12th state of the Confederacy.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace unity and reconciliation today. Just as divided landscapes once sought common ground, you may find your heart bridging gaps in your own relationships. It is a good time to release past frictions and accept new alliances. Trust that your intuitive spirit can transform internal conflicts into a beautiful, harmonious tapestry of belonging.
frase_do_dia: Healing old divisions allows your true, vibrant spirit to flourish in peace.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the wisdom of experience.
conselho: Seek common ground with others and let go of any lingering defensive walls.
